title: Crystal Sign
text: Place six spiritual crystals across the top two crafting rows and a stick in the bottom center to make three crystal signs.

Place on the ground or a wall. It emits light level 12 and supports editing, dye, glow ink and wax on its front text. Forge a crystal sign in the assembly table center with six infused crystals around it to make a Marvelous Wisdom Sign, which displays randomly drawn statements on both sides.
